how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the MBMC website. The notice says applications not made on this form within the deadline will not be accepted.
Paste a passport-size photograph in the box on the form and sign below it.

Fill in your full name in Marathi and in English capital letters. Then add your permanent and current addresses, phone number, email, date of birth, age, sex, nationality, whether you are domiciled in Maharashtra, marital status and the languages you know.

content_sections.heading: About MBMC
content_sections.text: Mira Bhayandar Municipal Corporation is the civic body for Mira Bhayandar in Thane district, Maharashtra. Its Public Health Department works from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bhavan, Nagar Bhavan, Mandli Talav, Bhayandar (W). The person appointed will work at the corporation's Bharatratna Indira Gandhi Hospital in Mira Road.

content_sections.heading: MBMC Mammography Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A degree in the science faculty from a recognised university, with Radiology as a subject. 3 years' experience as a Mammography Technician in a government-recognised hospital. Knowledge of Marathi is required. The application form also has a section for computer qualifications (MSCIT or an equivalent recognised course). Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: MBMC will check the applications it receives and prepare a draft merit list of eligible candidates. Appointments will be made from this list in order of merit, based on MBMC's needs and the notice's terms and conditions. Selected candidates must report for appointment with their original eligibility and experience documents, a passport-size photograph and one set of self-attested photocopies. MBMC will not write to candidates who are found ineligible.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The first appointment order will be for six months, on an honorary, purely temporary basis. The selected candidate must join within 3 days of receiving the appointment order. The job requires at least eight hours of duty a day, depending on the hospital's needs. The head of department sets the working hours. Because this is an essential service, extra work may be needed when required. The post is entirely honorary and on contract. It gives no right to claim a permanent post, absorption into MBMC service or the benefits of permanent staff. Candidates also cannot take this claim to court. MBMC may end the appointment without notice. It does not have to give one month's notice. To resign, you must give at least 15 days' written notice. If you do not, that month's honorarium will not be paid. Service can be ended without notice for doubtful integrity, misconduct or improper behaviour, misleading seniors, absence or disobeying orders. It can also be ended at any stage if your work is not satisfactory. The Medical Health Officer or head of department decides what the work involves. The Commissioner may change the number of posts or other details, change the process, or cancel the recruitment at any stage without giving a reason. Your candidature will be cancelled automatically if you are found ineligible or if you use misconduct or pressure at any stage. If you have already been appointed, the appointment will be ended.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MBMC Mammography Technician Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the MBMC website . The notice says applications not made on this form within the deadline will not be accepted. Paste a passport-size photograph in the box on the form and sign below it. Fill in your full name in Marathi and in English capital letters. Then add your permanent and current addresses, phone number, email, date of birth, age, sex, nationality, whether you are domiciled in Maharashtra, marital status and the languages you know. List your educational qualifications from Class 10 upwards, giving percentages only. Do not give grades, SGPA or CGPA. Then add any additional qualifications and your computer qualification. Give details of your experience: the institution, whether it is government, semi-government or private, the period, the total time and why you left. Answer the question on court, criminal or disciplinary cases, list the copies you are attaching, and sign the declaration. Complete and sign the undertaking (हमीपत्र) stating that no criminal case is registered against you. Submit the application by 5.00 pm on 10 November 2026 at: Public Health Department, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bhavan, Nagar Bhavan, Mandli Talav, Ground Floor, Bhayandar (W), Tal. Dist. Thane - 401101. Attach self-attested true copies of your mark sheets and certificates as proof of age, educational qualification, marks and experience. Applications will be rejected if candidates are not eligible, if the form is incomplete or wrongly filled, or if these copies are missing. The Public Health Department can be contacted at [email protected] or by phone on 022-28192828 / 28193028.

faq.question: Q1. Where will the Mammography Technician work?
faq.answer: At MBMC's Bharatratna Indira Gandhi Hospital in Mira Road, operating the mammography machine.

faq.question: Q2. Is Radiology compulsory in the degree?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice asks for a science degree from a recognised university with Radiology as a subject.

faq.question: Q3. What kind of experience counts?
faq.answer: You need 3 years as a Mammography Technician in a government-recognised hospital.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need to know Marathi?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice lists knowledge of Marathi as a requirement.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the first appointment?
faq.answer: The first appointment order is for six months, on an honorary and purely temporary basis.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply by email?
faq.answer: No. The application must be submitted offline at the Public Health Department, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bhavan, Nagar Bhavan, Mandli Talav, Ground Floor, Bhayandar (W), Thane - 401101.

faq.question: Q7. How should I fill in my marks on the form?
faq.answer: Give percentages only, starting from Class 10. The form says not to enter grades, SGPA or CGPA.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: At least eight hours a day, depending on the hospital's needs. Extra work carries no extra honorarium, and pay is based on biometric attendance.

faq.question: Q9. How soon must a selected candidate join?
faq.answer: Within 3 days of the appointment order. Bring your original documents, a passport-size photograph and one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if I resign without notice?
faq.answer: You must give at least 15 days' written notice. If you don't, that month's honorarium will not be paid.
